hero.title: Send anything. To any device. Instantly.
hero.body: Move any file between iPhone, Android, Windows, Mac, and Linux. Nearby it's instant and end-to-end encrypted — not nearby, a link they open in any browser. <highlight>No app on their end.</highlight>
hero.footnote: Free · No account · iOS · Android · macOS · Windows · Linux

appFrame.caption: Direct · device to device · no server

differentiators.title: What nothing else does at once.
differentiators.sub: AirDrop is Apple-only. Quick Share skips iPhones. LocalSend needs its app on both ends. BIShare closes all three gaps.

noApp.title: The recipient needs no app
noApp.body: Not nearby? Send a link they open in any browser to download. They install nothing, sign up for nothing — you can send a file to literally anyone.

platform.title: Every platform
platform.body: iPhone, Android, Windows, Mac, Linux — one app, every direction.

private.title: Private by design
private.body: Nearby transfers are end-to-end encrypted and never touch a server. Links auto-expire in 24h.

speed.title: Local-network speed
speed.body: On the same Wi-Fi, files go directly device to device — no cloud round-trip, no size ceiling from an upload.

live.title: Send a real file, right here.
live.sub: Up to 10 GB free from this browser — no install, no account. You get a link, a QR code, and a 6-character code. This is the same flow the recipient sees: they just open the link.

features.title: Built for the way files actually move.

speed.title: Local-network speed
speed.body: On the same Wi-Fi, files fly directly device to device — no cloud round-trip.

links.title: Secure links, 24h
links.body: Off-network? A link that works in any browser and auto-expires in a day.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.body: Share with a group over a short room code — everyone grabs what they need.

qr.title: Scan to receive
qr.body: Point a camera at the QR and the download starts. Nothing to type.

platform.title: Every platform
platform.body: Native apps on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and Linux — one experience.

noAccount.title: No account
noAccount.body: No sign-up, no email, no profile. Install and start sending in seconds.

pick.title: Pick a device — or grab a link
pick.body: Nearby devices appear automatically. Not nearby? One tap gets a link, QR, and code.

encrypt.title: It's encrypted and sent
encrypt.body: Sealed with AES-256-GCM before a byte leaves. Nearby goes straight device to device.

land.title: It lands, verified
land.body: Arrives intact, decrypts only on the receiving device. Links expire after 24 hours.
